close_reason: Superseded by PKIX-amgn.5 commit c70821b4 + PKIX-amgn.7 commit 27d67955: pkix-lint bumped 0.4.0 → 0.5.0 (BREAKING) with rationale in Cargo.toml; pkix-lint-cabf bumped 0.1.0 → 0.2.0 (first substantive content). Workspace Cargo.toml comment section + workspace.dependencies pins updated. CHANGELOG gained both a per-crate 'pkix-lint 0.5.0 + pkix-lint-cabf 0.2.0: CA/B Forum bundle migration' entry and an umbrella 'Workspace: framework / policy split' entry spanning PKIX-amgn.4/.5. Migration-by-example shows Cargo.toml additions and three before/after Rust import blocks.
description:
## Why

PKIX-amgn.5 is a breaking change for `pkix-lint` (`pkix_lint::cabf_tls_br` is removed) and a major content release for `pkix-lint-cabf` (first substantive code). Both deserve a version bump and a CHANGELOG entry under the workspace-root `CHANGELOG.md`.

## What

1. `pkix-lint/Cargo.toml:3` — bump `version = "0.4.0"` → `version = "0.5.0"`.
2. `pkix-lint-cabf/Cargo.toml:4` — bump `version = "0.1.0"` → `version = "0.2.0"`.
3. Workspace root `Cargo.toml` — update the `pkix-lint-cabf = { path = "pkix-lint-cabf", version = "0.1.0" }` workspace inheritance pin to `0.2.0` (currently around L81).
4. Workspace root `CHANGELOG.md` — add two entries near the top, in the standard format used by adjacent entries:
   - `### pkix-lint 0.5.0` — "BREAKING. `pkix_lint::cabf_tls_br` moved to `pkix-lint-cabf`. Callers should import the same items from `pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br`. The framework + RFC 5280 lints remain in `pkix-lint`." (PKIX-amgn.5)
   - `### pkix-lint-cabf 0.2.0` — "First substantive release. Ships `cabf_tls_br` module with six CA/B Forum TLS BR lints (`ValidityMaxLint`, `Sha1ProhibitedLint`, `RsaMinKeySizeLint`, `SanRequiredLint`, `EkuServerAuthLint`, `BcCaFlagLint`) and `CabfTlsBrProfile`. Reference / not authoritative interpretation; fork and adapt to your deployment's current BR reading." (PKIX-amgn.5)

## Acceptance

- [ ] `cargo check --workspace` clean after version bumps.
- [ ] CHANGELOG entries land in workspace-root `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Both crates' versions match the workspace inheritance pin.

## Out of scope

- The file moves and code changes that trigger the breaking change — that's PKIX-amgn.5.2 / .5.3 / .5.4.

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.5.2 (can run in parallel with .5.3 and .5.4 once .2 lands).
title: Version bumps + CHANGELOG entries for pkix-lint and pkix-lint-cabf
